title: release-publish
description: Publishes a crate with cargo publish for nx release publish, with one call for the crates of each Cargo workspace and registry in a batch, after the checks that the release design asks for.

dryRun.description: Verify the crates without uploading them, passed as --dry-run. nx release publish --dry-run sets it.

registry.description: Nx's npm registry option, which nx-rust does not map to a Cargo registry: a task that receives it fails before cargo runs and says how Cargo chooses a registry.

firstRelease.description: Set by nx release publish --first-release. It changes nothing: the executor still leaves out versions that the registry has.

nxReleaseVersionData.description: The versions that nx release passes to its publish step. It changes nothing.

pluginVersion.description: The plugin's version, which the plugin sets. Not meant to be set by hand.
